description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the PerformanceReviewDao component within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It includes setup routines, various test cases for retrieving, creating, updating performance reviews, as well as handling exceptions and status checks.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PerformanceReviewDao, testing its various data retrieval and manipulation methods within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the PerformanceReviewDao instance and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceReviewList
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of performance reviews based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceReviewCount
methods.description: Tests counting performance reviews based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetEditableReviewById
methods.description: Tests retrieving an editable performance review by its ID, checking for both existing and non-existing review cases.

methods.name: testGetSupervisorRecord
methods.description: Tests retrieving supervisor records for an employee, including existing, non-existent, and past supervisors.

methods.name: testCreateReviewWithTransactionException
methods.description: Tests that creating a review correctly throws a TransactionException if an underlying exception occurs.

methods.name: testUpdateReviewWithTransactionException
methods.description: Tests that updating a review correctly throws a TransactionException if an underlying exception occurs.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceSelfReviewStatus
methods.description: Tests retrieval of self-review status descriptions based on the reviewer status.

methods.name: testUpdateReviewerComment
methods.description: Tests updating a reviewer's comment and verifying the change in the database.
